messages:
trey_sales: Customer redlined with MFN (broad), 12-mo price hold, and a $0.013/token marketing cap. POC next week — need quick alignment. Excerpt:

“Customer shall receive pricing at least as favorable as any third party for substantially similar services. Provider shall not increase prices for 12 months. Public promotions shall not exceed $0.013/token.”

mira_dealdesk: Broad MFN + year lock is risky. Recommend: 1) narrow MFN to customers with comparable committed spend & package; 2) exclude short promos (<$40k) and marketplace; 3) convert 12-mo hold into a prepaid hosted commit.

alan_legal: I'll draft counter: MFN limited to sustained commercial offers (>=60 days) and customers with materially comparable commitments. Carve-outs for trials, partner-funded promos, and marketplace. Price hold conditioned on prepaid commit or tiered bands.

zoe_se: POC note: their test traffic is bursty — we should tie MFN to committed units and add a true-up if POC usage > forecast by 25%. Also reserve right to exclude feature-differentiated pricing (e.g., Dedicated).

kevin_revops: Proposed bands: $75k (10% off), $200k (18% off), $400k (25% off). If commit < $150k, limit price hold to 90 days. Will sign off if legal scopes MFN and no-retro clause included.

mira_dealdesk: I'll prepare a short offer: hosted-prepay + limited MFN + promo carve-outs. Need legal redline before I share with customer.

trey_sales: Thanks — I'll tell customer we're preparing a counter and need verbal on commit bands to start POC.
